setup.title: Settings
setup.intro: Set up your organization, its offices, units of measure and document numbering.

validation.officeCode: Use 2–10 capital letters or digits, e.g. MAD.
validation.unitCode: Use up to 20 capital letters, digits, - or _.

organization.title: Organization
organization.intro: Names, logo, contact details and financial settings used on every document.
organization.baseCurrencyHint: Exchange rates are entered against this currency.
organization.baseCurrencyLocked: Fixed because purchase requisitions have already been submitted.
organization.doaReferenceCurrencyHint: Approval amount bands are expressed in this currency.
organization.timezoneHint: Decides the date and year of submissions, e.g. Africa/Khartoum.
organization.maxBackdateDaysHint: How many days before submission a requisition date may be (0–365).
organization.logoHint: PNG, JPEG, WEBP or SVG, up to 2 MB. Earlier logos stay on documents already printed.
organization.logoInvalid: Choose a PNG, JPEG, WEBP or SVG image of at most 2 MB.

onboarding.title: Create your organization
onboarding.intro: You will be its Organization Admin. Default units, roles, PR numbering and approval steps are added for you and can be changed later.
onboarding.alreadyMember: You already belong to an organization.
onboarding.adminHint: Optional. Your email address is used when left empty.

offices.title: Offices
offices.intro: Offices and locations. The office code is part of every PR number.
offices.dialogIntro: Enter the office's names in both languages and a short code.
offices.codeHint: 2–10 capital letters or digits, e.g. MAD. It appears in PR numbers.
offices.codeLocked: The code cannot change because purchase requisitions already use it in their numbers.
offices.name: Name
offices.empty: No offices yet. Add the first one.

units.title: Units of measure
units.intro: Units used on requisition lines. Deactivate a unit instead of deleting it.

numbering.title: Document numbering
numbering.intro: Format of purchase requisition numbers. Sequences restart every year for each office.
numbering.paddingHint: The sequence is padded with zeros to this many digits (1–10).
numbering.futureOnly: Changes apply only to numbers assigned from now on. Existing numbers never change.

common.noOrganization: You are not a member of any organization yet. Ask your organization's administrator for an invitation.
common.homeIntro: Choose an item from the menu to get started.
common.invalidDate: Enter a valid date as DD/MM/YYYY

auth.magicLinkSent: We sent a sign-in link to your email.
auth.acceptInviteIntro: Choose a password for your account to finish joining.
auth.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 8 characters.
auth.inviteLinkInvalid: The invitation link is invalid or has expired. Ask for a new invitation.

users.title: Users
users.intro: Invite people, assign their roles and offices, and suspend access.
users.inviteIntro: They receive an email with a link to set their password and join the organization.
users.editIntro: Changes apply from now on; past signatures keep the name and position they were signed with.
users.positionTitleHint: Printed on the signatures this user makes.
users.orgWideAccessHint: Without this, the user only sees records of the offices ticked below.
users.name: Name

fieldErrors.already_member: This email already belongs to a member of the organization.

roles.title: Roles
roles.intro: A role is a set of permissions. Default roles can be edited too.
roles.editorIntro: Tick the permissions that holders of this role receive.
roles.inUse: This role cannot be deleted while users hold it or an approval rule requires it.
roles.name: Role

approvalRules.title: Approval rules
approvalRules.intro: Who checks and approves each type of document, by office and amount (delegation of authority).
approvalRules.name: Rule name
approvalRules.orgWide: All offices without their own rule
approvalRules.financeLocked: Every requisition goes through the finance check first, whatever the amount.
approvalRules.bandsIntro: Amounts are the requisition total converted to {currency}.

issues.band_gap: The amount ranges leave a gap.
issues.band_not_open_ended: The last amount range must have no upper limit.
issues.band_empty: Each range’s upper limit must be above its lower limit.
issues.role_not_found: Choose a role for every step.
issues.office_not_found: The selected office does not exist.
issues.no_rule: No active approval rule applies to this office.
issues.kind_not_allowed: This step type is not allowed here for this document type.

approvalRules.previewIntro: See which steps a requisition would go through and how many users can sign each one.
approvalRules.checkLocked: Every voucher goes through the check first, whatever the amount.

import.title: Import budget lines
import.intro: Upload an Excel (.xlsx) or CSV file. Valid rows become budget lines; invalid rows are listed with the reason and nothing is created from them.
import.columnsHint: Columns: code, description, category, amount. Codes are kept exactly as written (e.g. 2.2.31, 010). Maximum 5 MB.

rates.title: Exchange rates
rates.intro: Manual rates entered by Finance. A document uses the latest rate on or before its date; on the same date the most recently entered rate applies.
rates.correctionIntro: This rate is used by a purchase requisition and cannot change. The corrected rate is saved as a new entry for the same currency and date and applies from now on.

actions.title: Actions
actions.approveIntro: Your name and position are stored with the signature and printed on the PR.
actions.rejectIntro: Rejection is final. The budget held by this PR is released and the requester is notified.
actions.returnIntro: The requester can correct and resubmit the PR with the same number. The budget held is released until then.
actions.resubmitHint: Resubmitting keeps the PR number and restarts the approvals from the finance check with current exchange rates.

changeBudgetLine.intro: Move a PR line to another budget line of the same grant. Its reserved amount moves with it.

reassign.noUsers: No other user is eligible for this step.

frozen.title: Grant suspended or closed
frozen.body: This PR cannot be approved while its grant is not active. It can still be returned, rejected or cancelled.

cancel.title: Cancel the purchase requisition
cancel.intro: The PR stays on record as Cancelled and its number is never reused. Any budget it holds is released.
cancel.approvedWarning: This PR is already approved. Cancelling it releases its committed amount back to the budget line.
cancel.othersWarning: This PR belongs to another user. They will be notified that you cancelled it.
